title: Whole numbers in, decimal out
prompt: Both values are whole numbers, but the answer must keep its decimals: solve(7, 2) is 3.5. Return a divided by b.
starter:
func solve(a, b) -> float:
	return a / b
hints: Dividing two whole numbers throws the decimals away.
Turn one of them into a float before dividing.

docs.name: float(number)
docs.what: Returns the number as a float, so dividing keeps decimals.

solution:
func solve(a, b) -> float:
	return float(a) / b
